Option C was chosen on 2026-11-12. Each account gets a real `projects` folder, and sbd pins every session's auto-memory to `~/.claude/projects/<ClaudeFolder.name(main checkout)>/memory` through `autoMemoryDirectory` in the per-session `--settings` file. The refactors (`ClaudeFolder.name` and the per-session settings file) are in draft PR #256. The plan is `~/dev/someone/notes/Dev/repositories/someone/switchboard/plans/shared-projects-permissions.md`.

**Why:** a symlink anywhere on the path removes Claude's built-in allowances. When the target is under `~/.claude`, writes are refused as "a sensitive file". The user's decisions: accept the memory split for sessions outside sbd, include memory folders in the clones, and stop sbd, the automation jobs, and the sessions for the migration.

**How to apply:** don't start Stage 1 (pinning memory) until #256 merges. The user asked for that on 2026-11-12, and an sb wait on the merge is set. Stage 2 (dotfiles) and Stage 3 (migration) each need the user's approval. Rerun the Phase 0 probe on `~/.claude-automation` once its spend limit resets.
